title: Is DF's extra animal structural (E42c)? E42b: a written {2,1} gave ravens and emus three, never four. Here {1,1} on BIRD_RAVEN, BIRD_EMU and KANGAROO, every other land species at frequency 1, the three at 100; the surface released every 1,500 ticks.
fork: The group-size promise at one: 'exactly one' or 'one, sometimes two'.

predictions.model: the raw's max is honoured at one
predictions.expects: every wave of the three is 1

kill_criterion: no wave above 1 in either replicate makes the promise 'exactly one'
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: size1
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.enabled=false; cfg.groups.enabled=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.disableSched(); print('tool disarmed')

local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local rs=sw.getEmbarkRegions(); local want={}; for _,t in ipairs({'BIRD_RAVEN','BIRD_EMU','KANGAROO'}) do want[t]=true end; local n=0; for _,pop in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do local cr=df.creature_raw.find(pop.race); if cr and want[cr.creature_id] and sw.managedPop(pop, rs, sw.LAYER_SET.land) then pop.quantity=500; pop.flags.extinct=false; n=n+1 end end; print(('x: %d entries stocked at 500'):format(n))

local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local rs=sw.getEmbarkRegions(); local land={}; for _,pop in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do if sw.managedPop(pop, rs, sw.LAYER_SET.land) and df.world_population_type[pop.type]=='Animal' then land[pop.race]=true end end; local n,o=0,0; for i,cr in ipairs(df.global.world.raws.creatures.all) do if false then elseif cr.creature_id=='BIRD_RAVEN' then cr.frequency=100; n=n+1 elseif cr.creature_id=='BIRD_EMU' then cr.frequency=100; n=n+1 elseif cr.creature_id=='KANGAROO' then cr.frequency=100; n=n+1 elseif land[i] then cr.frequency=1; o=o+1 end end; print(('x: %d named species set, %d other land species at frequency 1'):format(n,o))

local n=0; for _,cr in ipairs(df.global.world.raws.creatures.all) do if cr.creature_id=='BIRD_RAVEN' or cr.creature_id=='BIRD_EMU' or cr.creature_id=='KANGAROO' then cr.cluster_number[0]=1; cr.cluster_number[1]=1; n=n+1 end end; print(('x4: %d species written to cluster {1,1}'):format(n))
